title: Divide Multi-Digit Numbers Using an Algorithm
objective: I can divide multi-digit whole numbers and explain the meaning of the quotient and remainder.
model: the standard long-division layout worked one cycle at a time: Divide, Multiply, Subtract, Bring down, with the remainder smaller than the divisor

widgets.root: Identical to the lesson's warm-up; keys 280, 12, 5 × 40 = 200, 420 ÷ 7 = 60 verified.

The lesson's idea is the four-step algorithm and the studio has a step-by-step long-division manipulative (`ldiv`), yet the guided section is four-choice numeric items that can be answered by multiplying a choice by the divisor, with no step shown or required.
widgets.replacement: Use `act:ldiv` L1 for these four slots with params decimal:false: the student types the quotient digit, the product and the difference for each cycle, the next digit comes down by itself, and an estimate chip is graded with the final result. Keep the same four dividend / divisor pairs.

widgets.root: Both mistakes are algorithm slips the lesson names (stopping a cycle early; a quotient digit too large so the difference goes negative). Fixes 126 and 147 verified.
